correctness.rationale: PASS: The quotient forces positive evens exactly >=2m. The least odd b must be >=m since 2b is allowed, and adding 2m forces all odds beyond b+2m. All m-1 intermediate odds are free: even+odd enters forced tail, odd+odd enters allowed evens. Thus every S is exactly one Boolean layer. None of b∪B can be generated from smaller odd choices and 2O_m because positive even increments >=2m and three odds >=3b>=b+2m. The genus is 2m-2+(b-1)/2-|B|. Writing b=b0+2h and r=1+|B| yields g=g0+m-r+h, and directly choosing B gives binomial coefficients, the bivariate OGF, and precise stabilization; boundary m=2 included. Independently reconstructed closure for 558 cases m=2..6 and h=0..8.
